data.narrative:
Black Forest Labs, a Series B AI & Software company founded by Robin Rombach, Andreas Blattmann, and Patrick Esser, is evaluated against a universe of 9 private and 1 public comparable across the frontier AI sector. The company's last post-money valuation was $3.25B on $300M total raised.

Two valuation methods triangulate a defensible range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to subsequent-stage progression, yielding $6.2B. Peer-median methodology references six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Figure AI ($39.0B Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B Series C), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B Series C), Together AI ($8.3B Series A), and one additional peer—producing a median valuation of $12.0B, with a range spanning $5.6B to $39.0B.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation band of $5.2B (low) to $13.8B (high), with a median of $9.1B. The wide peer range and stage heterogeneity of comparables create material uncertainty around appropriate valuation multiples. The current $3.25B post-money sits at the low end of the methodological range, suggesting either meaningful upside potential or material risk depending on revenue trajectory, capital efficiency, and competitive positioning relative to stated peers.
